text:
Maria L: Quick heads-up: staging will run a Key Vault rotation drill tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Goal is to validate our envelope-encryption flow (data-key rewrap + KV crypto ops) and AKS pod identity access. Anyone on-call?

Ajay P: I can be available. One question — are staging vaults using RBAC or legacy access policies? That changes how we grant CryptoUser permissions.

Ben C: Staging is mostly RBAC (we migrated most vaults last quarter). A couple of older vaults are still in access-policies mode. Note: SDKs doing wrap/unwrap need the right key permissions (either via RBAC roles or access policy).

Sara T: For AKS pods: user-assigned managed identity (UAMI) must have role assignment at the vault scope. If you're using k8s service account -> UAMI mapping, verify the annotation. Also the legacy pod-identity addon is deprecated — use workload identity or AAD pod identity replacement.

Maria L: Action items: Ben — run checks on role assignments and key permissions. Ajay — confirm our rewrap logic pins key version (we should avoid silent rewrap to a newer key version during the drill).

Ben C: Running checks now. Example commands I ran: 
```
az role assignment list --assignee <principalId> --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault>
az keyvault key show --id https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/keys/<key-name>
```
Found one pod SA using a service principal from another tenant (cross-tenant SP) — that will fail under RBAC unless the SP exists in this tenant or we use a managed identity.

Ajay P: That's the tenant boundary issue we've seen. For cross-tenant SPNs, our options are: invite as guest and create local SP, or switch to UAMI on the AKS cluster. Prefer avoiding cross-tenant SPs in prod.

sec-bot: Reminder: enable KeyVault diagnostic logs (KeyVaultAuditEvents) to a storage account + Log Analytics before rotation. We need telemetry for every rewrap. Link: https://aka.ms/kv-diagnostics

Maria L: Good catch. Please enable diagnostics if not already set. Also test our fallback: if wrap/unwrap fails we should fall back to cached DEK and fire an alert to the incident channel (do not silently rotate).

Ben C: Test results summary: wrap/unwrap succeeded for 3 of 4 keys. The failing one had role assignment at resource-group scope but not vault scope — RBAC crypto ops require role assignment at the vault (or higher) scope specifically for key operations. I'll add a fix script.

Ajay P: Should we migrate the remaining access-policy-mode vaults to RBAC before attempting prod rotation? Migration window?

Maria L: Yes — plan: 1) migrate leftover vaults to RBAC and disable legacy access policies, 2) add UAMI role assignments for AKS workloads, 3) enable diagnostics (KeyVaultAuditEvents) and retention, 4) run rewrap + canary on staging, 5) escalate on any failures. Runbook located at: https://confluence.internal/runs/kv-rotate-2026

Ben C: :thumbsup: I'll open a tiny PR with an az automation script that: checks role assignments, ensures key permissions, rotates key versions, exercises wrap/unwrap, and posts results to #incidents if anything fails.

Sara T: FYI for storage account CMKs: remember to update storage's key rotation policy and make sure our DEK metadata references the new key version during re-encrypt. Blob-level rewrap can be slow — plan for throttling.

Maria L: Thanks all. I'll post status here after the staging run. Tagging @Sara T for morning checks and on-call.
